claims.claim: my deliberate plays are less predictable to the algorithm.
claims.referee: a chronological holdout: train on the past, test on the future. the gap fell from d=0.62 to d=-0.02, and the interval brackets zero.

claims.claim: my body steers what i play.
claims.referee: partial out the 24-hour cycle and run phase-randomized surrogates. rho fell from 0.36 to 0.07. a shared daily clock made it.

claims.claim: world listening primes jazz three weeks later.
claims.referee: split the series by how each play started. the whole effect lives in autoplay auto-advance and is null under shuffle.

claims.claim: i am choosing more over time.
claims.referee: the logger gained a new back-button code, and the way plays were logged shifted. hold both fixed and the rise is about zero. the instrument changed, not me.

claims.claim: changepoint detection found 5 of 5 known dates.
claims.referee: score the hits against shuffled dates. it also finds events that never happened.

claims.claim: one known date shifted listening across eleven metrics.
claims.referee: a pre/post window on all eleven: 11 of 11 null. it stays on this wall: hiding nulls is how honest analysis turns into selection bias.

claims.claim: my physiology narrows my listening, even with activity controlled.
claims.referee: remove the annual cycle. a shared season, not a cause.
use shuffle as the instrument, so the choice is not mine. the effect is gone. it was the activity, not the music.

claims.claim: my genre mix drifted on its own.
claims.referee: moving-block bootstrap plus intent stratification. mostly the platform's surfacing, not my drift. one exception stays: electronic climbing is mine.

claims.claim: i can predict my own next presses from audio and history.
claims.referee: an out-of-time split: train through 2024, test on 2025 and later. whatever drives a next press is not in the audio.

claims.claim: a model that sees my body and my listening beats either alone.
claims.referee: a block bootstrap on the held-out gain. it survived the circadian partial-out, then died in the bootstrap.

claims.claim: an artist's bridge role in my taste graph predicts whether i drop it.
claims.referee: retrain with the future hidden. the map had been trained on the whole timeline, so it already knew who i would abandon. blind it and the edge is gone.

claims.claim: my timing-only intent proxy ports to a public log of 992 listeners.
claims.referee: its own pre-declared gate, plus the same readout run back on my log. the intervals were valid. the construct was not.

claims.claim: the deeper autoplay wanders, the closer plays get to preference-free.
claims.referee: hold the track fixed with a matched conditional logit. the curves were real, but depth was not the cause.

claims.claim: 19 of every 100 plays were my press, the same in every year.
claims.referee: an era audit against the logger's own changepoints: the rate swung from about 12 to about 23 across 2023, so 19 is an average over that change. the strict count, 11.5, held steady.

claims.claim: my top artist topping the chart four straight years is wildly improbable.
claims.referee: a null that keeps persistence. the old null re-rolled my taste every january. with persistence, a four-year reign is just a plateau.

shape: gone: the effect the claim needs is not there once checked. less: a smaller true thing stays. swing: the steady number moved. flip: the wrong sign. found: short form of each grave's result in src.
